item.title: @faytuksnetwork: A Karbala court sentenced an ISIS member to life imprisonment for plotting attacks against pilgrims during the 2026 Arba
item.description: A Karbala court sentenced an ISIS member to life imprisonment for plotting attacks against pilgrims during the 2026 Arbaeen observance. Iraq’s judiciary says he circulated instructions for making explosive devices and drones intended for terror operations.
item.content:encoded:
@faytuksnetwork

A Karbala court sentenced an ISIS member to life imprisonment for plotting attacks against pilgrims during the 2026 Arbaeen observance. Iraq’s judiciary says he circulated instructions for making explosive devices and drones intended for terror operations.

item.description:
Trump says the Iran war will be “put away” very soon, “one way or another,” in an interview with RSBN on the sidelines of his rally in Dubuque, Iowa.
“Either they’ll make a deal, or we just end it. I guess you could say maybe the easy way.”
